items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: I have a concert for the Beethoven, that is one of the goals.

ctx.x: Yeah. Wow. Do you have any other goals? I mean do you have a goal of leading your own band?

Yeah, I think in jazz life, they don’t have any goals. Like every day is important. Like classical — I have a concert for the Beethoven, that is one of the goals. You know, right? And becoming professor at some university. But jazz life every day is kind of new things. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -11-
Sometimes unexpected things happen on the bandstand. Like Junior yesterday suddenly started to play in a different key.
